docs.title: Emergency red flags in cats
docs.content_en: Seek emergency veterinary care for black or tarry stool, a large amount of fresh blood, repeated vomiting or inability to keep water down, difficulty breathing, seizures, collapse or severe weakness, a male cat straining with little or no urine, suspected poisoning or foreign-body ingestion, or a painful/bloated abdomen. Do not wait for the cat to look critically ill, and never give human medication.
docs.content_zh: 出现黑便或柏油样便、大量鲜血、反复呕吐或无法喝水、呼吸困难、抽搐、倒地或极度虚弱、公猫频繁蹲猫砂盆却几乎尿不出来、怀疑误食毒物或异物、腹部胀痛时，请立即急诊。不要等到猫看起来很严重，也不要自行给人用药。
docs.source: VCA Animal Hospitals; Cornell Feline Health Center

docs.title: Vomiting and hairballs in cats
docs.content_en: Occasional hairballs (roughly monthly or less) in a bright, eating cat are often not alarming. See a vet if hairballs occur more than once a month or increase; if vomiting lasts more than 1–2 days or occurs more than once a week; or if there is lethargy, appetite loss, weight loss, diarrhoea, blood, pain, dehydration or suspected foreign-body/toxin ingestion. Repeated unproductive retching is urgent. Do not give human anti-nausea or pain medication.
docs.content_zh: 偶尔吐毛球（大约每月一次或更少）且精神食欲正常，通常不必过度担心。若毛球超过每月一次或越来越频繁；呕吐持续超过1–2天或每周超过一次；或伴随精神差、食欲下降、体重下降、腹泻、吐血、疼痛、脱水、怀疑异物或毒物，请就医。反复干呕却吐不出东西属于紧急情况。不要自行使用人用止吐药或止痛药。
docs.source: VCA Animal Hospitals — Vomiting in Cats; Cornell Feline Health Center

docs.title: Loss of appetite in cats
docs.content_en: A cat that has not eaten properly for 24 hours needs veterinary attention; kittens under six weeks and overweight cats need help sooner. Prolonged anorexia can cause hepatic lipidosis (fatty liver), which can be fatal. Do not force-feed or give human appetite stimulants. Offer wet food, warm it slightly and try different textures while arranging a vet visit.
docs.content_zh: 猫超过24小时没有正常进食就需要看兽医；六周以下幼猫和肥胖猫要更早就医。长时间不吃可能引发脂肪肝，甚至致命。不要强行灌食或使用人用食欲刺激药。可以在预约兽医期间尝试湿粮、稍微加热食物或不同质地，但不要拖延就医。
docs.source: Cornell Feline Health Center — Anorexia; VCA Animal Hospitals

docs.title: Water intake and hydration
docs.content_en: Cats naturally drink little. Support hydration with multiple water bowls, a fountain, wet food and clean bowls away from the litter box. Signs of dehydration include tacky gums, skin tenting, sunken eyes, lethargy and reduced urine. Persistent thirst or a sudden change in water intake warrants a vet check.
docs.content_zh: 猫天生喝水少。可以用多个水碗、流动饮水机、湿粮，并把水碗放在远离猫砂盆的安静位置。脱水迹象包括牙龈发黏、皮肤回弹差、眼窝凹陷、精神差和尿量减少。持续口渴或饮水量突然变化应让兽医检查。

docs.title: Diet changes and food safety
docs.content_en: Transition food gradually over 7–10 days, mixing increasing amounts of the new food. Avoid human food, spoiled food and sudden diet changes. Feed measured portions at set times and always provide fresh water. If your cat stops eating for 24 hours, consult a vet.
docs.content_zh: 换粮建议用7–10天渐进过渡，逐步增加新粮比例。避免人类食物、变质食物和突然换粮。定时定量喂食，并始终提供新鲜饮水。若猫超过24小时完全不吃，请咨询兽医。

docs.title: Urinary obstruction in cats
docs.content_en: A male cat straining in the litter box with little or no urine may have a urethral obstruction — an absolute emergency that can become fatal within hours. Do not squeeze the bladder or give human pain medication. Go to an emergency vet immediately. Prevention includes hydration, wet food, weight control, stress reduction and litter-box hygiene.
docs.content_zh: 公猫频繁蹲猫砂盆却几乎尿不出来，可能是尿道阻塞，属于绝对急症，数小时内就可能危及生命。不要挤压膀胱或使用人用止痛药，请立即去急诊。预防包括增加饮水、湿粮、控制体重、减少应激和保持猫砂盆清洁。
docs.source: Cornell Feline Health Center — FLUTD; VCA Animal Hospitals

docs.title: Medication safety for cats
docs.content_en: Never give cats human medications without veterinary direction. Acetaminophen/paracetamol, ibuprofen, aspirin, naproxen and other human pain relievers can be fatal. Do not use human anti-diarrhoeal drugs, laxatives or enemas. All medication — including probiotics, dewormers and anti-nausea drugs — must be assessed and dosed by a vet. If a cat eats a medication or poison, contact a vet or poison control immediately.
docs.content_zh: 不要在没有兽医指示的情况下给猫使用人用药物。对乙酰氨基酚／扑热息痛、布洛芬、阿司匹林、萘普生等人用止痛药可能致命。不要使用人用止泻药、泻药或灌肠剂。所有药物（包括益生菌、驱虫药、止吐药）都必须由兽医评估并确定剂量。若猫误食药物或毒物，请立即联系兽医或宠物中毒中心。
docs.source: Cornell University Hospital for Animals — Small Animal Toxins; University of Illinois

docs.title: Weight and body condition
docs.content_en: Weigh your cat regularly and assess body condition. Gradual weight gain may be linked to overfeeding and inactivity; sudden weight loss can indicate illness. Do not put a cat on a crash diet without veterinary supervision, because rapid weight loss can cause fatty liver disease.
docs.content_zh: 定期称重并评估体态。逐渐变胖可能与喂食过多和缺乏运动有关；突然变瘦可能提示疾病。不要在没有兽医监督下让猫急速减肥，因为快速减重可能引发脂肪肝。
docs.source: Cornell Feline Health Center; VCA Animal Hospitals

docs.title: Vaccines, parasites and preventive care
docs.content_en: Regular vaccination, parasite control, dental care and veterinary check-ups are important. Follow your vet’s schedule for core vaccines, deworming and flea/tick prevention. Dental disease and chronic kidney disease are common in older cats and are easier to manage when found early.
docs.content_zh: 定期疫苗、驱虫、口腔护理和体检很重要。按兽医建议安排核心疫苗、驱虫和跳蚤／蜱虫预防。牙病和慢性肾病在老年猫中常见，越早发现越容易管理。

docs.title: Behaviour changes and enrichment
docs.content_en: Sudden behaviour changes — hiding, aggression, scratching or not using the litter box — can be caused by stress, environment or illness. Rule out medical causes first. Provide scratching posts, vertical space, puzzle feeders and quiet hiding places, and keep routines stable.
docs.content_zh: 突然的行为改变（躲藏、攻击、抓挠、乱尿）可能来自压力、环境或疾病。先排除身体疾病，再考虑环境丰富化：提供猫抓板、垂直空间、益智喂食和安静的躲藏处，并保持作息稳定。

docs.title: How to take a good waste-analysis photo
docs.content_en: For the AI waste analysis, use a clear, well-lit photo with the stool centred and unobstructed by litter. The model classifies stool appearance; colour and texture descriptions in the app are typical for the category, not measurements from the photo. The result is for reference only and cannot replace a vet’s diagnosis.
docs.content_zh: 使用 AI 排泄物分析时，请提供清晰、光线充足、粪便位于画面中央且不被猫砂遮挡的照片。模型会对粪便外观进行分类；App 中的颜色和质地是该类别的典型描述，不是从照片中测量得到的。结果仅供参考，不能替代兽医诊断。

docs.title: Stool colour guide
docs.content_en: Brown, formed stool is typical. Black/tarry stool may indicate upper GI bleeding — emergency. Fresh red blood suggests lower GI bleeding or irritation — see a vet if repeated or significant. Yellow/orange/green or pale/greasy stool can indicate liver, gallbladder, pancreatic or fat-absorption problems — see a vet if persistent. White rice-like specks may be tapeworm segments.
docs.content_zh: 褐色、成形的粪便是典型正常表现。黑色／柏油样便可能提示上消化道出血，属于急症。鲜红色血便提示下消化道出血或刺激，反复或大量时请就医。黄色／橙色／绿色或苍白／油腻的粪便可能提示肝胆、胰腺或脂肪吸收问题，持续时请就医。白色米粒状物可能是绦虫节片。
docs.source: VCA Animal Hospitals; iCatCare; Cornell Feline Health Center

docs.title: What normal cat stool looks like
docs.content_en: Normal cat stool is usually medium to dark brown, well-formed, sausage-shaped, soft but pliable, and passed roughly once a day. Small day-to-day changes are normal; a persistent change in colour, texture or frequency is more meaningful.
docs.content_zh: 正常猫粪通常为中至深褐色、成形、香肠状、柔软有弹性，大约每天一次。日常小幅变化是正常的；持续的颜色、质地或频率改变更值得注意。
